explanation: The October 28, 2015 statement introduced notably more hawkish forward guidance by explicitly stating the Committee would assess 'whether it will be appropriate to raise the target range at its next meeting' — a direct signal that a December hike was being actively considered, representing a material shift from prior language. This specific forward guidance change, telegraphing an imminent liftoff, plausibly explains a structural break in financial market data around November 6, 2015, as markets repriced the probability of a December rate hike substantially upward.
